source:
yamaa: "1.0"
type: spec
domain: TEST
keys: [ID]
input: {SRC: unread.csv}
output: {path: result.csv, columns: [ID, V]}
columns:
  - {name: ID, type: str, label: ID, derivation: SRC.ID}
  - name: V
    type: str
    label: V
    derivation:
      case:
        - when: 'FALSE'
          then: {mapping: {source: SRC.X, dict: {Y: 1, y: 2}, case_sensitive: false}}
        - otherwise: 1
